images.subject: A large prototype plasma containment ring dominates the image: one large metal torus with an open inner channel.
images.detail: The whole inner channel is packed with thick, dense, blazing ropes of magenta-pink plasma that twist around the entire ring and glow brightly, lighting the metal and the bench.

images.subject: A large prototype plasma containment ring dominates the image: one large metal torus with an open inner channel.
images.detail: A wide, thick, blazing band of dense magenta-pink plasma fills the whole inner channel all the way around the ring, a bright continuous glowing torus of plasma with swirling filaments, casting strong magenta light on the metal ring and the bench.
